Order form C-025: line item "Implementation & license — one-time" $36,000; payment due at signing; service start 2025-02-01; scope: "platform deployment and user onboarding for up to 40 seats"; governed by Master Subscription Agreement v3.2.

Policy #2: implementation services are recognized *as performed* only where separately priced distinct services were *actually delivered*; self-serve onboarding is not an implementation service.
